## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle ritual offering manual by **Śubhakarasiṃha** ([善無畏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%84%A1%E7%95%8F)) accompanying the *Susiddhikara-sūtra* ([KR6j0061](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0061), T18n0893a). The text codifies the *gòngyǎng* (offering / *pūjā*) sequences for the *Susiddhikara* tradition. It is one of two parallel recensions of the same ritual codification (companion to T894b = [KR6j0064](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0064) in two-fascicle form).

**Abstract**

The *Gòngyǎng fǎ* gives the systematic offering-ritual structure for the *Susiddhikara* practice — the *kriyā*-tantra offering sequence covering the preparation of substances, the *mudrā*-mantra-visualisation sequences for each offering, and the merit-dedication. The text is a working ritual manual paired with the foundational *Susiddhikara-sūtra* itself.

The translation dates from Śubhakarasiṃha's mature Chángān period (724–735).
